hero.subtitle: From training to placement, we guide Ethiopian workers on their path to safe, successful international careers.

about.title: About Us
about.heroSubtitle: Transforming lives through training, trust, and opportunity. Every worker has a story — we help write the next chapter.
about.missionTitle: Empowering Lives, One Story at a Time
about.missionText1: Skills for Life Training PLC transforms how Ethiopian workers access safe, well-paid opportunities abroad. We combine industry-focused training, rigorous compliance support, and transparent processes to prepare candidates for international work.
about.missionText2: Our goal is to remove barriers, eliminate hidden costs, and equip every trainee with practical skills and guidance so they can thrive overseas and return with experience that strengthens their communities.
about.missionText3: We believe in a human-first approach that prioritizes worker safety, fair treatment, and long-term success for both workers and employers.
about.coreValuesSubtitle: The principles that guide every decision, every training program, and every relationship we build.
about.goalsSubtitle: Our goals are to make overseas employment safe, fair and sustainable for Ethiopian workers. We focus on:
about.journeySubtitle: From a vision to a movement — milestones that shaped who we are today.
about.workersSubtitle: Our dedicated team of training specialists, career counselors, and support staff work together to ensure the best learning outcomes for our students.

values.humanCenteredDesc: We prioritize people over processes. Every interaction is personal, respectful, and meaningful.
values.excellenceDesc: We maintain the highest standards in training, ensuring quality education and exceptional learning experiences.
values.trustDesc: Transparency and integrity guide everything we do. We build lasting relationships based on trust.
values.impactDesc: We measure success by the positive impact we create in people's lives and communities.

goals.regularLegalStatusDesc: Ensuring workers have accurate, lawful passport, visa, and work permit arrangements.
goals.fairCostsDesc: Maintaining transparent and reasonable fee structures to prevent unnecessary expenses.
goals.workerSafetyDesc: Prioritizing protection from exploitation, abuse, and forced labor through vetting, contracts, and support.
goals.reintegrationImpactDesc: Enabling returning workers to share skills and spark local development.
goals.nationalRepresentationDesc: Promoting Ethiopia's cultural strengths and professionalism abroad.
goals.jobCreationDesc: Partnering with authorities and employers to expand opportunities for citizens.
goals.responsibleRemittanceDesc: Guiding workers to use secure, legal channels for sending money home, supporting national prosperity.

story.title: The Journey
story.subtitle: From aspiration to achievement — every worker has a story. Here's how we help write it.

beginning.title: The Beginning
beginning.subtitle: A Dream Takes Root
beginning.description: Every worker starts with a dream — to provide for their family, to build a better future, to gain skills that matter. At Skills for Life, we meet them at this moment of possibility.

training.title: The Training
training.subtitle: Skills That Transform
training.description: Through comprehensive, hands-on training programs, workers develop not just technical skills, but confidence, safety awareness, and professional readiness. Every module is designed with real-world application in mind.

certification.title: The Certification
certification.subtitle: Recognition & Credibility
certification.description: Internationally recognized certificates validate their expertise. This piece of paper represents months of dedication, countless hours of practice, and a commitment to excellence.

placement.title: The Placement
placement.subtitle: A New Chapter Begins
placement.description: With proper documentation, legal support, and ongoing guidance, workers embark on their international journey. They carry with them not just skills, but hope, determination, and the support of our team.

impact.title: The Impact
impact.subtitle: Stories of Success
impact.description: Years later, these workers return with experience, savings, and new skills. They invest in their communities, start businesses, and inspire the next generation. The cycle continues.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text1: At Skills for Life Training PLC, we believe that every individual deserves access to quality education and skill development. Our mission is to empower people with the knowledge and skills needed to transform their lives and build successful careers.
mission.text2: We combine professional training programs with practical, hands-on learning to deliver exceptional results for our students and partners. Every training program is a step toward a more skilled, confident, and prosperous future.
mission.text3: Trust, excellence, and genuine care for our students are at the heart of everything we do.

admin.title: Team & admin
admin.subtitle: Super admins manage users, enrollments, and leads; admins share most tools; field staff use /desk only
admin.forbiddenBody: Only staff, admins, and super admins can open this portal. Ask a super admin to set your profile role in Supabase (e.g. staff or admin), or sign in with the correct account.
admin.bootstrapHint: Owner email skillsforlifeethio@gmail.com is promoted to super_admin on sign-in when SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY is set (and optional BOOTSTRAP_SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL). SQL fallback: update public.profiles set role = 'super_admin' where id = (select id from auth.users where email = 'skillsforlifeethio@gmail.com');
admin.staffPortalCardBody: Add students and talents captured in the field. Your list shows only records you submitted; admins see everyone.
admin.seedDataNote: Edit that file to change jobs.
admin.dashboardDataNote: Public forms post to Supabase. Run the latest migrations if counts stay at zero after testing submissions.
admin.usersSubtitle: Roles, access, bans, and account removal
admin.roleHierarchyLead: One role per user. CV downloads require employer, staff, admin, or super admin.
admin.roleHierarchyL1: Trainee — default for new accounts; program enrollments; no CV downloads.
admin.roleHierarchyL2: Employer — hiring partner; CV downloads enabled.
admin.roleHierarchyL3: Staff — internal team; CV downloads enabled.
admin.roleHierarchyL4: Admin — user management and admin screens; CV downloads enabled.
admin.roleHierarchyL5: Super admin — everything above plus full control (do not remove your only super admin).
admin.roleHierarchyNote: Do not delete public.profiles rows while leaving users in Authentication — the app auto-repairs the signed-in user, and you can use Save here to recreate a missing profile row.
admin.missingProfileHint: Save this row to create the profile in the database.
admin.deleteConfirmHint: Type the user email to confirm
admin.enrollmentsNotifyHint: New enrollments appear under Enrollments. With Resend API keys set, a full application copy is emailed to skillsforlifeethio@gmail.com (override with ADMIN_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL).
admin.enrollmentCvError: Could not open the secure CV link. Try again or check storage configuration.
admin.enrollmentCvSecurityNote: CV files are stored privately in Supabase. Download uses a short-lived signed URL and requires a super admin session. Configure RESEND_API_KEY to receive email alerts for each new application.
admin.messagesSubtitle: Contact form messages, employer worker requests, and candidate shortlist requests from the site.

admin.regionalRoleHint: Super admins: promote field staff in Supabase (public.profiles.role = 'staff') or use User management. Staff see only their own submissions; Admin and Super admin see all regional talent records.
